title_en: Prudential Financial and Dai-ichi Life Holdings sign a memorandum toward a strategic business alliance
summary_en: On 23 January 2025 (US time), Prudential Financial, Inc. and Dai-ichi Life Holdings signed an initial memorandum of understanding on a strategic partnership. It was relayed in Japan by Prudential Holding of Japan on 24 January. Prudential would pick Dai-ichi's wholly owned Neo First Life as exclusive supplier of certain products in Japan, with sales through Prudential Life's Life Planner channel under consideration. Prudential's PGIM would also provide asset management, such as structured products and private credit, to Dai-ichi group companies. No start dates are given.

title_en: Status of initiatives based on the 'Points of focus for further upgrading compliance and risk management systems in the sales representative channel'
summary_en: On 26 Dec 2025, Prudential Holding of Japan said that its two life insurers, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life, had reported their progress against the Life Insurance Association's guidance on compliance and risk management for the sales-representative channel. The reports also take account of the Association's follow-up survey, which began in Feb 2023, and of its April 2025 update to the guidance. The company apologised for financial misconduct by group employees and committed to further strengthening controls. Details are posted on each insurer's website.

summary_en: On 22 April 2026, Prudential Holdings of Japan, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life reported on compensation for customers harmed by money-related misconduct by sales staff. Of 498 affected customers (¥3.08 billion) in the cases Prudential Life disclosed on 16 January, the independent Customer Compensation Committee had finished review or compensation for 259 (¥1.70 billion) as of 17 April. About 700 reports are awaiting fact-checking, including about 70 relating to Gibraltar Life. The group aims to finish compensation by autumn 2026 and will publish progress roughly quarterly.

title_ja: 再発防止に向けた抜本的な構造改革の実施のためプルデンシャル生命における新規契約の販売活動の自粛期間を180日間延長
title_en: Extension of the voluntary suspension of new contract sales at Prudential Life by 180 days to implement fundamental structural reform to prevent recurrence
summary_en: On 22 April 2026, Prudential Holdings of Japan and Prudential Life Insurance announced a 180-day extension of the suspension of new-policy sales at Prudential Life. The suspension began on 9 February and was first set for 90 days. The extension is for structural reform after financial misconduct by sales staff and former staff. The planned changes cover executive roles and authority, branch management, a new compensation system and cultural change. Existing policyholders and their benefits are unaffected, and other group insurers are not covered by the suspension.

title_ja: お客さまへの補償の進捗状況について
summary_en: Prudential Holdings of Japan, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life announced on 24 July 2026 an update, as of 8 July, on compensation for customers harmed by improper money-related conduct by current and former sales employees. Of the 498 customers (¥3.08bn) in the 16 January disclosure, 437 (¥2.85bn) have been reviewed or compensated, and 184 of them are eligible for payment. Of 365 later claims reviewed, 125 (¥790m) are eligible. The independent Customer Compensation Committee does the reviewing, and the companies plan to publish progress each quarter.

title_ja: お客さまへの補償の進捗状況について（2026年9月16日時点）
title_en: Progress of compensation to customers (as of 16 September 2026)
summary_en: On 8 October 2026, Prudential Holding of Japan, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life reported compensation progress as of 16 September 2026 for customers harmed by employee misconduct involving money. For the 498 customers (¥3.08bn) in the 16 January case at Prudential Life, 492 are resolved and 6 (¥3m) are still under review. For other claims at both insurers, the independent compensation committee has finished 848 reviews, and 329 customers (¥2.57bn) qualify for payment. The companies plan to publish updates roughly quarterly.

title_ja: 金融庁による行政処分について
title_en: Regarding administrative action by the Financial Services Agency
summary_en: On 9 October 2026, Prudential Holding of Japan, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life said the FSA had ordered Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life to suspend soliciting and concluding insurance contracts from 13 October 2026 to 31 January 2027. The suspension applies to their sales employees, and Gibraltar Life's agency channel is excluded. Both insurers also received business improvement orders, as did the holding company. All three must submit improvement plans by 30 November 2026. The orders follow misconduct involving money handled by sales employees. Servicing of existing policies continues.

title_ja: シニアオフィサー人事について
改善諮問委員会の設置について
title_en: Establishment of an Improvement Advisory Committee
summary_en: On 4 November 2026, Prudential Holding of Japan, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life announced that the holding company set up an Improvement Advisory Committee in October. It has four independent outside experts and will advise on the business improvement plans the companies are drawing up after the FSA administrative action of 9 October 2026. Its remit covers how sufficient and effective the plans are, and clarifying management responsibility. Its first meeting was held on 28 October, and regular reviews will follow.
